purpose: Teach: 同性/宣教師/レッテル/滅び/検察庁/結社/投融資/自虐

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、同性愛の歴史的研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the history of same-sex relationships, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, steady check-in. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Eyes engaged, posture open. Acknowledging her work with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、宣教師の渡来史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the historical arrival of missionaries and their influence.
lines.style: Direct and present. A slight lift of confidence on the opening 'yes.' Clear-eyed, not performing. Settling into the topic naturally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会的レッテルの問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the social impact of labeling in that context, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Inviting her to expand. Warm curiosity — not testing, genuinely wanting to understand her thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、古代文明の滅びを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how ancient civilizations declined and what social labels played in that process.
lines.style: Steady and direct. No apology in her voice. Building on what came before. A thread of genuine interest visible beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 検察庁の制度史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also looked at the institutional history of the prosecutor's office in your research, correct?
lines.style: Slight shift to more formal registering the scope of her work. Still warm. Acknowledging the breadth without overwhelming her. Inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の秘密結社を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about secret societies during wartime and how institutions handled dissent.
lines.style: Voice grounded and present. Not rushed. A note of careful precision as she names what she actually studied. Slight pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 海外投融資政策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you brought in the history of overseas investment policy as well, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle wonder that she covered so much ground. Reflective tone — almost thinking out loud with her. Warm acknowledgment of her ambition.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、芸術の自虐表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed self-deprecating and subversive artistic expression under those economic pressures.
lines.style: Quieter close. Steady and sure on her final point. A slight breath before 'self-deprecating' — naming something she clearly thought carefully about. Finishing with quiet conviction.
